Class ProgressBarBuilder

java.lang.Object
au.ellie.hyui.builders.UIElementBuilder<ProgressBarBuilder>
au.ellie.hyui.builders.ProgressBarBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
BackgroundSupported<ProgressBarBuilder>, LayoutModeSupported<ProgressBarBuilder>, ScrollbarStyleSupported<ProgressBarBuilder>
public class ProgressBarBuilder extends UIElementBuilder<ProgressBarBuilder> implements LayoutModeSupported<ProgressBarBuilder>, ScrollbarStyleSupported<ProgressBarBuilder>
Builder for creating progress bar UI elements. Progress bars are used to display the completion status of a task or process.
